answer: In a channelization system, each agent must prove traversal of a unique tundra path whose terrain seeds a sonnet-shaped cryptographic proof, verified in 0.87s by one-off epoch narrators. A Sybil must wander this path, costing 0.87s of GPU time per identity as the oasis-like navigator rejects precomputed proofs after 24 hours. The narrators are rate-limited by the last honest agent's epochs, preventing batching.
